mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with torsemide may cause significant hypokalemia and hyponatremia from loop diuresis, increasing risk of hypokalemic complications and potentially dangerous blood pressure fluctuations; MAOIs can also potentiate sympathomimetic effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes closely, particularly potassium and sodium; assess blood pressure regularly; consider alternative diuretic or ensure adequate potassium supplementation if combination is necessary.
